summary: Verified textbook async ingestion + extract-topics 409/400 fix end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed covering OCR binary presence (pdftoppm + tesseract), async upload returns status=ingesting immediately (<15s), status flips to indexed within ~1-2s for small PDFs, extract-topics returns 200 with topics list once indexed, returns 400 with 'no indexed text available' for extraction_failed textbook (Physics ICSE 2026.pdf existing in DB), and regression endpoints (/api/papers, /api/qbank, /api/competitive-exams) all reachable. Frontend: uploaded small PDF via UI as admin, row appeared, polling refreshed the list and the newly-uploaded row transitioned to indexed automatically (Extract Topics count increased from initial state to 24 after upload). The transition for the small text PDF was <2s so the visible 'Processing PDF...' label was not captured in the screenshot window, but the code path is verified (button code sets disabled + 'Processing PDF...' label whenever status==='ingesting', confirmed in Textbooks.jsx lines 273-287). 409 response for extract-topics-while-ingesting is also verified via backend test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1406 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold for splitting; consider extracting textbook routes, paper routes, and startup bootstrap into separate modules.

Async upload uses fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task(_ingest()) without storing a reference — if the process is killed mid-ingest the textbook can be stuck in 'ingesting' forever. The startup 'recovered orphaned pending' logic covers papers/solutions but does NOT cover textbooks stuck in 'ingesting' state. Recommend extending the startup recovery block to reset stale ingesting textbooks (e.g. older than N minutes) to extraction_failed.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded and cleaned up TEST_UIPhysics + TEST_Physics textbooks; no residual test data.
